summary: Manage equipment covered by a service contract
description:
We want to track the equipment installed at our customers' sites and covered by a service contract.

Create an Équipement table with: the name, a unique serial number, the equipment type (Climatisation, Chauffage, Électricité, Plomberie), the commissioning date, the warranty end date, the customer account and the service contract. A 'Sous garantie' (under warranty) flag must be calculated automatically from the warranty end date.

A form is needed, a view of equipment under warranty, access from the Service Client app (Contrats group) and permissions for the Gestionnaire de contrats role (read, create, write). No documentation exists: start it.
acceptanceCriteria:
- The Équipement table exists in the Alchemist solution with its columns.
- Two equipment records cannot have the same serial number.
- 'Sous garantie' is Oui if the warranty end is in the future, Non otherwise.
- The form shows every field; the 'Équipements sous garantie' view lists them.
- Equipment is accessible in Service Client, Contrats group.
- The Gestionnaire de contrats role has Read, Create, Write (business unit) on equipment.
- The documentation (index, table, feature) is created.

comments.author: Dataverse Alchemist
comments.body: Delivered. Équipement table: 7 columns, including 'Sous garantie' as a Power Fx formula (rhz_datefingarantie >= UTCToday()), alternate key on the serial number, Information form, 'Équipements sous garantie' view, 'Équipements' entry in Service Client (Contrats group), Read/Create/Write (business unit) for Gestionnaire de contrats. Solution: 14/14. End-to-end: under warranty Oui/Non correct, duplicate refused (HTTP 412), the view only lists the equipment under warranty. Documentation started in docs/ (index, 4 tables, feature pages).
